Care instructions

After use, wash the mold with warm soapy water using a soft sponge to remove any residue. Avoid abrasive cleaners or metal scrubbers to maintain the non-stick surface. Dry thoroughly before storing to prevent rust. Do not use in dishwashers or expose to sudden temperature changes to preserve the mold's integrity.
